parts.t: Welcome to 29436 Duncan Avenue – a fully renovated family home in Aberdeen! This beautifully updated property features a gated front entrance, wide driveway, and loads of parking. Renovations completed in 2022 include new roof, windows, siding, furnace, hot water tank, large permitted addition, re-insulated attic, and spacious new deck with direct yard access from the main floor. Enjoy a new heat pump & a/c, 200 amp underground service, 2 gas hookups outside, and wiring to the back of the property. Located on a quiet street less than a minute from Ross Elementary!
